notes.title: Upcoming Discount Bundle & New Game
notes.content:
To celebrate the launch of our new title; [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2023050/Lighthouse_Keeper/]Lighthouse Keeper[/url] tomorrow, we're creating a bundle that includes all of our Steam games with a 30% discount!

The bundle will include;
- Lighthouse Keeper
- Havsala : Into the Soul Palace
- Meow Express
- Viral Firar

If you've purchased any of the items above beforehand, it's price will be deducted from the bundle.


You can add [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2023050/Lighthouse_Keeper/]Lighthouse Keeper[/url] to your wishlist to get the notification when the game becomes available tomorrow, the discount bundle drops soon after!

Have any questions? Just drop a comment and we're here to answer! :)

notes.title: First Month Patch
notes.content:
- When the dairy-listen prompt is activated via the ear button; the voiceover now starts from the current page.
- Fixed a couple of inconsistencies between voiceover and text.
- Fixed a couple of localization bugs
- Made a few bugfixes (telescope, lumberjack in the book of goddess, duplication in the closet etc.)
- Minor UI bugs fixed.
- Added a new easter egg.

notes.title: Beta Build Update
notes.content:
New Beta version now available!

- Added more clues for the first puzzle of Chapter 1.
- Added more clues and artwork for the Pythagoras Puzzle.
- Book pages that contain hints now light-up.
- New Artwork: Important characters' head statues are now available in the library.

Also; small artwork additions and bug-fixes.

Thanks to everyone who participated on our beta test. We're looking forward to hear from you on our next version :)
